A company with 90% of its team in Hyderabad built two generations of AI chips for under $50 million. In February 2025, NXP Semiconductors bought it for $307 million.
India has one fifth of the world's chip designers. Engineers in Bengaluru helped design Intel's Xeon server chips, the processor inside the Redmi Note 8 Pro, and a 2nm chip for Qualcomm. After 40 years of this work, India still owns almost none of the IP.
So why has India never turned its chip talent into chip companies? And what changed in the last two years?
